notes: OXIDE — a single-file pixel-art & animation studio. Layers and frames (cel matrix) with per-frame durations, onion skin, tile preview, mirror painting, Bayer dither ink, pixel-perfect pencil, flood fill with tolerance, shift-snapped shapes, rectangular marquee with floating cut/paste/move, HSV picker, six curated palettes plus palette-from-art, rect-patched undo/redo (80 steps), autosave with session restore, project JSON save/open, PNG import (auto canvas growth), PNG frame / spritesheet / animated GIF export (hand-written GIF89a+LZW encoder, verified pixel-exact against an independent decoder). Ships with a procedurally generated 4-frame ember sprite on three layers. All art, icons, sounds (opt-in) and UI are code-generated; no external assets or libraries. Known limitations: GIF transparency is 1-bit (alpha>=128 threshold) with frequency-based color reduction above 255 colors; selection is rectangular only; no tablet pressure support; touch supports one-finger drawing and two-finger pan/pinch but no long-press menus.
